scenario: Five-minute actual-App integration soak, bullet-validation seed, desktop in-app Chromium, landscape viewport
notes: Fixed production QA bundle served during soak; no hot reloads. 48 shots/s, 1200 m/s, 1600 m range, 100 m / 1 s trails; repeated scans, target spawning, camera changes, rolls, glass debug toggles, resets, pauses, and origin changes.
CPU categories overlap and must not be added. Very short operations round to zero at browser timer resolution. Measurements include instrumentation overhead.
GPU resource counts plateaued during the last minute; heap varied with garbage collection. This is bounded-run evidence, not a formal leak proof.
The run did not saturate every hard pool. Dedicated automated exhaustion tests cover skipped launches and resource reuse.
There were isolated long frames; the 183.3 ms maximum means stutters are not fully eliminated. No phone measurements or universal FPS claim.
The paired same-route comparison is CPU-only in bullet-simulation-performance.json. A paired full-render phone median-frame acceptance comparison remains unmeasured.
Follow-up quick-tap input, simultaneous input-release, zero-velocity settling, and continuous-surface muzzle shader refinements were checked separately after this frozen-bundle soak.
